question: How many substitute players are there on a Beach Volleyball team?
solution:
The correct answer is __**0.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __ Key Points__

__
 
• Beach Volleyball teams do not** **have substitute players.
 
• **Played on a sand court divided by a net, beach volleyball is a team sport between two teams of two or more players.**
 
• The goal of the game is to send the ball over the net and land it on the court's opponent's side, much like **indoor volleyball.**
 
• In order to stop the other team from grounding the ball on their end of the court, each team collaborates as well.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **While the contemporary two-player game started in Santa Monica, California, beach volleyball most likely began in 1915 on Waikiki Beach in Hawaii.**
 
• Since the Summer Olympics in **1996, **it has been an Olympic sport.
 
• **The FIVB Beach Volleyball World Championships and World Tour are organized by the Fédération Internationale de Volleyball (FIVB), which also serves as the sport's worldwide regulatory body.**
